description: Synthetic centered-clearance and lateral-interference square-peg cases for insertion-boundary development plumbing; not instrumented physical insertion evidence.

metric_definitions.minimum_clearance_error: Predicted signed minimum lateral clearance in meters for comparison with a future hidden physical label.
metric_definitions.contact_sequence: Whether side contact occurred during insertion.
metric_definitions.penetration: Maximum negative MuJoCo contact distance converted to nonnegative meters.
metric_definitions.insertion_success_boundary: Whether the final insertion depth reached the public target within tolerance.
metric_definitions.replay: Exact digest agreement across two complete executions of each case.
